findings.description: Institution verification timelines differ: GO-5.1 mandates 15 days, while MIN-4 mandates 10 days.
Annual family income limits differ: GO-3.2 sets the limit at Rs. 2,50,000, whereas COR1-1 raises it to Rs. 3,00,000.
COR1-1 supersedes GO-3.2 by amending the annual family income limit for eligibility to Rs. 3,00,000.
GO-4.3 refers to Annexure A for uploading certificates in the prescribed format, which is not provided among the sources.
